name: Popover
description: Rich content anchored to a trigger, with an optional arrow, that flips when there is no room.

props.name: children
props.description: A button that opens the popover, then the Popover.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Open state (controlled). Use defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the popover opens or closes.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where it opens relative to the trigger, e.g. "top", "right", "bottom start". It flips to the opposite side when there is no room.

props.name: offset
props.description: Gap from the trigger in pixels, with room for the arrow.

props.name: crossOffset
props.description: Shift along the trigger's edge in pixels.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description: Flip to the other side when there is no room.

props.name: isNonModal
props.description: Leave the rest of the page interactive while open.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Labels the popover when it has no heading with slot="title". Falls back to the trigger's label.

props.name: children
props.description: The content, with an optional PopoverArrow. A function receives close().

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the surface, e.g. a width. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Popover.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. The arrow is drawn in the popover's fill and hairline and turns to face the trigger.
